subject: Request to reinstate trial credits and timeline for onboarding
messages:
From: Max Patel <max@olivetech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T15:22:00Z
Subject: Trial credits expired — request to reinstate for onboarding finish

Hi Kimberly,

Appreciate you taking my call earlier. We were in the middle of evaluating Redwood when our procurement/legal review stretched longer than expected and the trial credits on our sandbox expired. That window caught us right before we were ready to validate latency and embeddings at scale.

Given the work we've already done and the fast follow-up from the engineering team here, would Redwood consider reinstating a small pool of trial credits (enough for a week of sustained testing) so we can wrap the PoC and finalize a purchase order? We're targeting a production pilot by mid-November; restoring access now will get us there faster.

I've attached our purchase_order.pdf so you can see the timeline and internal approvals. Happy to share more context or jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Max Patel
Head of Platform Engineering
Olive Tech
attachments: purchase_order.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Max Patel <max@olivetech.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T18:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Trial credits expired — request to reinstate for onboarding finish

Hi Max —

Thanks for the details and for sending the PO. I'm sorry the legal timing impacted your run; we do have a one-time contingency for cases like this. I can provision a temporary top-up of credits to your sandbox to cover a week of testing while we finalize the commercial paperwork.

If that works for you, next steps from our side:
- I'll open a small approval with Credit Ops and route for a one-off reinstatement (we'll tie it to the PO and the HubSpot opportunity).
- Jordan (cc'd) will own closing the purchase order and pricing details.
- Mateo (cc'd) can schedule a 60-minute deep-dive this week to make sure the tests exercise KV cache and batching — that will maximize the value of the top-up.

I've attached our onepager-credit-policy.pdf so you have the guardrails. I'll follow up once Credit Ops confirms the exact quantity and expiration.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: onepager-credit-policy.pdf

Subject: Re: Trial credits expired — request to reinstate for onboarding finish

Thanks Kimberly — that sounds promising. Two quick asks from our security and procurement groups before we execute:

1) Can you include the SOC 2 Type II redacted evidence or a link to the attestation? They request a copy for the PO file.
2) Can you confirm the expected expiration date of any reinstated credits so we can plan test runs?

If you can provision the credits this week, we'll schedule Mateo's deep-dive session and aim to sign the PO within 7–10 business days.

Best,
Max

attachments: purchase_order.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T14:12:00Z
Subject: Credit Ops approval — one-time sandbox top-up issued

Hi Max / Team —

Thanks for the context. Credit Ops has reviewed Olive Tech's PO and the activity logs. We've approved a one-time sandbox credit reinstatement: 50k token-equivalent test credits, expiring 2026-10-20T23:59:59Z.

Notes and conditions:
- Credits are tied to the Olive Tech sandbox account ID in HubSpot and are non-transferrable.
- This top-up is intended to validate model/latency and embeddings for the PoC; it is not a commercial discount.
- If you hit the limit, please let us know and Jordan will coordinate next steps (purchase, short-term dedicated capacity).

I attached a redacted SOC2 evidence pack and included the DocuSign link for the temporary credit terms we require to tie the top-up to the PO. Please have an authorized signee complete the DocuSign (link below). Once signed, we will finalize the credit allotment (should be active within 1 hour of signature).

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/abcd-olivetech-credit-agreement
attachments: SOC2-redacted.pdf

Best,
Soojin Lee
Credit Operations Lead, Redwood Inference

Hi Max —

Thanks — I can confirm the DocuSign was completed a few minutes ago by your procurement lead and we've applied the 50k token credits to your sandbox account. You should see the allotment reflected in the Console under 'Usage > Credits' within the hour.

Next steps I propose:
- Mateo will reach out to schedule the 60-minute technical deep-dive tomorrow to validate test cases and cost targets.
- I'll coordinate the PO kickoff internally to ensure we have a clean path from trial to paid pilot (RDW-3281).
- If Olive needs a short-term dedicated quota during the pilot, ping me and I will prioritize.

Congrats on getting this over the line — excited to see the results.

Warmly,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
